title: Ask HN: In The Matrix, the bad guys are the 'agents'. Coincidence? Clairvoyance?
excerpt: Dr. Walter Gibbs: [laughs] You've got to expect some static. After all, computers are just machines; they can't think.
content_html:
Dr. Walter Gibbs: [laughs] You've got to expect some static. After all, computers are just machines; they can't think.

Alan Bradley: Some programs will be thinking soon.

Gibbs: Won't that be grand? Computers and the programs will start thinking, and the people will stop!
